text:
maria_chang: Heads up — nightly perf showed a regression when kv_prefetch was flipped on for the sm-probe path. Latency p50 jumped ~12% for seq_len 2048.

sam_dev: ugh, repro? logs?

maria_chang: repro in nightly-arch-7 run. I attached stripped perf samples: kernel dispatch counts up, and we appear to be picking the larger-matmul fastpath even when TF32/TensorCores shouldn't be used on this GPU.

sam_dev: can you paste the sm_probe output?

maria_chang: sure — snippet:
```
SM: 8.6
compute_capability: 86
tensor_cores: yes
bf16_atomic: partial
fp8_supported: no
quirks: no_fast_kv_prefetch
```

jon_patel: that `no_fast_kv_prefetch` hint is new from the 537 driver on some SKUs. If the cap-probe reports tensor_cores: yes we currently route to the TC matmul kernel but kv-prefetch path assumes different tiling and leads to extra syncs.

naveen_k: I instrumented the dispatch in local: for seq_len >= 1024 we prefer the seqlen-gated kernel which expects kv_prefetch=false. With kv_prefetch=true we end up inserting a prefetch stage that triggers a fallback to a slow memcpy path.

sam_dev: hmm, so two things: (1) sm-detect says TC available -> fast TC kernel chosen, (2) kv_prefetch toggles codegen that changes memory layout assumptions. Combination is causing misaligned shared memory usage and a sync stall.

ci-bot: nightly job nightly-arch-7/1719790000 finished. perf_regression_test: FAILED (p50 +11.9%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/arch7/1719790000

lynn_ops: can we gate the kernel pick by both sm flags and the kv_prefetch capability? e.g. prefer "tf32_tc_kernel" only if kv_prefetch=false OR sm_features.include('prefetch_safe')

jon_patel: yes — we should add an architectural capability "kv_prefetch_safe" computed from driver quirks + SKU table. Fallback policy: if kv_prefetch_safe==false then route to legacy matmul kernel that uses conservative prefetching.

maria_chang: quick profiling heap: top stacks show ~30% of time in _kv_shuffle_sync and a large number of block-level __syncthreads. flame: (short)
```
- matmul_tc_fast (chosen)
  - kv_prefetch_stage (extra)
  - kv_shuffle_sync
- fallback memcpy
```

sam_dev: action: add a probe flag `kv_prefetch_safe` default false for SKUs with driver >=537 and SM 8.6 until tested. Add unit for sequence lengths > 1024 to prefer legacy path.

naveen_k: I'll add a small microbenchmark to runtime/probes that verifies prefetch correctness (100 iterations, seq_len sweep). Will also emit a lightweight perf metric `kv_prefetch_stalls` to telemetry.

lynn_ops: timeline? this is causing customer-facing p50 regressions on a small cohort. Can we fast-follow a canary?

jon_patel: I can land a short-term guard in the routing: check (sm_tensorcores && kv_prefetch_safe) before choosing tc_fast. If false, pick `matmul_legacy_prefetch` kernel. PR inbound in ~2h.

sam_dev: great — add an explicit opt-in experiment flag `runtime.experimental.kv_prefetch_force` so we can test on canary nodes. Also add a perf test to prevent regressions in next nightly.

maria_chang: thanks. after jon's change, I can re-run nightly canary and post perf diff. Also need to update kernel-autotune doc with the sequence-length gating rules.

ci-bot: created ticket PERF-1129: "kv_prefetch + TC kernel misroute on SM 8.6" and linked the failing CI job.

naveen_k: note for the autotuner: capture (sm_version, driver_version, kv_prefetch_safe, seq_len_histogram) per workload. We can then learn the safe set instead of hardcoding.

lynn_ops: add that as acceptance criteria for the PR — metric emission + canary rollout plan.

jon_patel: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pulls/763 — includes routing guard + experiment flag + unit tests for seq_len boundaries.

maria_chang: running quick local canary now, will report in ~30m.

sam_dev: also check fp8/bf16 detection path — if bf16 is partial we should avoid certain TC kernels that assume bf16 atomic adds. Avoiding those reduced a related regression last quarter.

maria_chang: good call. adding to checklist.

lynn_ops: once PR merges, we'll roll to `dedicated-canary-1` with experiment on, then monitor p50/p95 and kv_prefetch_stalls metric for 2h. If looks good, widen to 10% of hosts.

maria_chang: update: local canary after jon's patch -> p50 back to baseline, kv_prefetch_stalls dropped to ~1% of prior. Will attach perf diff in the PR. :tada:

sam_dev: awesome, thanks everyone. Add postmortem blurb to eng-runtime/announcements if we need a larger roll back.

jon_patel: I'll merge after CI green and schedule canary rollout.

ci-bot: CI run runtime-tests/763 started.

maria_chang: thanks all — closing the loop once canary finishes.
